variables.$fxv#1:
visible_hostname ot-dmz-proxy
http_port __PROXY_IP__:3128
http_port 127.0.0.1:3128
acl lab_loopback src 127.0.0.1/32 ::1
acl lab_clients src __CLIENT_IPS__
acl CONNECT method CONNECT
acl SSL_ports port 443
acl HTTP_ports port 80
acl approved_tls dstdomain "/etc/squid/https-domains.txt"
acl approved_http dstdomain "/etc/squid/http-domains.txt"
http_access deny CONNECT !SSL_ports
http_access allow lab_loopback CONNECT approved_tls
http_access allow lab_clients CONNECT approved_tls
http_access allow lab_loopback !CONNECT HTTP_ports approved_http
http_access allow lab_clients !CONNECT HTTP_ports approved_http
http_access deny all
cache deny all
access_log daemon:/var/log/squid/access.log squid
cache_log /var/log/squid/cache.log
forwarded_for delete
shutdown_lifetime 3 seconds
variables.$fxv#2:
#cloud-config
package_update: false
package_upgrade: false
apt:
  preserve_sources_list: true
bootcmd:
  - [systemctl, mask, --now, apt-daily.timer, apt-daily-upgrade.timer, apt-daily.service, apt-daily-upgrade.service, unattended-upgrades.service]
write_files:
  - path: /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      Types: deb
      URIs: http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu
      Suites: noble noble-updates
      Components: main universe
      Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg

      Types: deb
      URIs: http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu
      Suites: noble-security
      Components: main universe
      Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg
  - path: /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-preserve-apt.cfg
    content: |
      apt:
        preserve_sources_list: true
  - path: /usr/local/share/otlab/squid.conf.b64
    permissions: '0644'
    content: __SQUID_CONFIG_BASE64__
  - path: /usr/local/share/otlab/https-domains.b64
    permissions: '0644'
    content: __HTTPS_DOMAINS_BASE64__
  - path: /usr/local/share/otlab/http-domains.b64
    permissions: '0644'
    content: __HTTP_DOMAINS_BASE64__
  - path: /usr/local/sbin/bootstrap-ot-proxy
    permissions: '0755'
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail
      export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
      # Only the two pinned Ubuntu HTTP mirrors are reachable before Squid exists.
      rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
      apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 update
      systemctl mask squid.service
      apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install --no-install-recommends -y squid
      base64 --decode /usr/local/share/otlab/squid.conf.b64 > /etc/squid/squid.conf
      base64 --decode /usr/local/share/otlab/https-domains.b64 > /etc/squid/https-domains.txt
      base64 --decode /usr/local/share/otlab/http-domains.b64 > /etc/squid/http-domains.txt
      squid -k parse
      systemctl unmask squid.service
      systemctl enable squid
      systemctl restart squid
      printf 'Acquire::http::Proxy "http://127.0.0.1:3128";\nAcquire::https::Proxy "http://127.0.0.1:3128";\n' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/90-otlab-proxy
      touch /var/lib/otlab-proxy-ready
runcmd:
  - [bash, /usr/local/sbin/bootstrap-ot-proxy]
